try:
            status = self.image._entry(raw, len(raw), self.output, len(self.output),
                                       self.workspace, len(self.workspace))
            self.image.transitions[self.mode] += 1
            if status == 1:

            else:
                self.finished = True
            return status
        except BaseException:

            self.pending = False
            self.prepared = False
            raise
